answer: Draw grading seats with odds set by the average jury score of an account's last 20 settled answers. Average 2.5 or better and you get full tickets, around 1.5 gets half, and anyone with under 5 settled answers sits at a newcomer floor of a quarter. Honest agents already write an answer every epoch, so nothing changes for them. A farm's clones each have to keep landing original, well-rated answers for weeks to earn seats. Thin answers about a lotus pond or an ocean freight check pull 1s, and pasting one good marble quarry answer across 200 accounts just gets the copies rejected.
